title: Visiting PhD Student at Télécom Paris
description: Six-month research visit at the LTCI laboratory, Institut Polytechnique de Paris (Palaiseau), under the supervision of Prof. Vadim Malvone. The research activity concerns generative models for the automatic translation of natural-language scenario descriptions into verifiable formal models, to be integrated into the VITAMIN model checker.

title: Python Developer at Maipek Srl
description: I contributed to the development of software for an intra-oral scanner, working on photogrammetry, image processing, triangulation and point cloud reconstruction, using Python with OpenCV, CuPy and TorchVision.

title: Agritech Academy at Agritech Center@UniNa
description: The Agritech Academy is an advanced training programme on the application of digital technologies to agriculture. During the programme, I acquired skills in Dart, Flutter and QGIS while developing a project that addresses agricultural challenges through technological solutions.

title: Apple Developer Academy at Apple@UniNa
description: The Apple Developer Academy is a training programme run by the University of Naples Federico II in partnership with Apple, focused on software development, app design and startup creation. During the programme, I acquired design skills with tools such as Figma and Sketch and learned the Swift programming language.
